name: Cool Days
source:
2019 is in the yard, this year all the events of the game begin. The protagonist's name is "Neo", he is the best in his school and, moreover, an excellent student. But one day the director calls him and asks him to become a tutor for one of the students who is not doing well with academic performance. Will this be a fatal mistake for Neo?

[From [url=https://unixie-games.itch.io/cool-days-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2019年即将到来，今年比赛的所有赛事都将开始。主角的名字叫“尼奥”，他是学校里最优秀的学生，而且还是一名优秀的学生。但有一天，主任打电话给他，让他成为一名学习成绩不好的学生的导师。这对尼奥来说会是一个致命的错误吗？

[来自[url=https://unixie-games.itch.io/cool-days-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
